title: Forecasting Sunspot Activity
summary: A test of whether an autoregressive model can forecast held-out annual sunspot activity better than a mean baseline.
question: How well does an 11-lag autoregressive model forecast the final 20 years of the sunspot dataset?
findings: Replace this text with the model and baseline mean absolute errors printed by experiment.py, and explain which performed better.
methods: The script loads the sunspots dataset from statsmodels, fits an autoregressive model with 11 lags, and evaluates it on the final 20 years against a baseline that predicts the training-data mean.
limitations: This evaluates one historical holdout period. It does not establish how well the model predicts future activity; describe any other important limitations of the data or approach.
